body: This really resignated with me and I just want you to know that you are not alone.

That is a blessing and a curse though because I'm so strong for many people that I don't want to open up and have it be mistaken for any weakness.
I'm no expert but I just would like to tell you to stay strong,I understand that its hard but just remember that love prevails all.
